summary: Iteration 2 retest of AutoTrade Pro after main agent fixes. All three reported critical bugs are RESOLVED. Backend 16/16 pytest pass (incl. previously skipped auto-trader test). Frontend dashboard renders EMA 9 + EMA 20 lines on AUDUSD chart alongside MA 20/50 and Bollinger. Auto tab shows the seeded 'AUD/USD Day Trader' strategy with EMA 9/20, SL 20p, TP 40p; Modifier modal exposes ema-fast=9 / ema-slow=20 inputs. Manual buy AUDUSD 0.10 lot produced €1.00 per pip (correct), confirming pip_size fix. Live auto position 'AUDUSD SELL 0.10 AUTO' visible in UI proving end-to-end auto-trading works.

minor.issue: Still does not re-seed strategies. Low impact since startup seed is now idempotent on name, but a reset followed by a strategy delete would leave the user with no default.

Old 'RSI + Bollinger Scalper' from iteration 1 still lives in DB alongside the new 'AUD/USD Day Trader'. Not a bug per se (idempotent additive seed), but main agent may want to either remove the old one or document that both are intentional.

action_items: Optional: have POST /api/account/reset also clear and re-seed strategies for a clean demo state.
Optional: remove the legacy 'RSI + Bollinger Scalper' from DB or label one of the two strategies as the canonical default in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: evaluate_signal still accesses ind['ema_fast'] / ind['ema_slow'] via bracket - now safe because compute_indicators always returns those keys, but a defensive .get(...) would make the loop crash-resistant if a future config disables EMA computation.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers when convenient.
verified: pip_size now uses spec['category'].startswith('Forex') - works for Majors/Minors/Exotics. PnL/€ per pip math validated end-to-end (0.10 lot AUDUSD = 1.00 €/pip).
seed_data_creation: Test opens & closes one 0.10 lot AUDUSD position per pytest run; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 retest items PASS. If main agent makes further changes, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_autotrade_api.py -v` (15s, 16 tests) plus quick playwright sanity check of dashboard chart lines and Auto tab strategy card.
rca_of_issue: N/A - iteration 2 verified previous RCAs were correctly fixed: (a) compute_indicators now returns ema_fast/ema_slow arrays, (b) pip_size category check uses startswith('Forex'), (c) AUD/USD Day Trader strategy seeded idempotently by name, (d) auto-trader loop no longer crashes and actively opens positions tagged opened_by='auto'.
